Okayyy this might be my new favorite way to order 7 Brew 😂🥤💕

I ordered my energy NO ICE + NO FILL so I could stick it in the fridge and save it for later! When I was ready, I added my own ice, cream & cold foam at home. 🙌🏼

And this combo?! 10/10 🔥 SO fruity!

My Drink Order:
🍑 Sunrise — Peach + Raspberry
No ice, no fill
🍌 Add Sugar-Free Banana
🧁 Add Cupcake

Would you order yours no ice to save for later?! 👀
